subject.title: feat(kimi): add Kimi K3 to the kimi-coding provider

question: Should OpenClaw deliberately migrate every existing `kimi/k3[1m]` selection to the `k3` wire model and change K3’s default thinking effort from max to high?
rationale: This is an external provider-contract and user-upgrade choice; repository tests can verify local mapping behavior but cannot establish the intended Kimi membership and wire-id policy without maintainer acceptance of the live-provider evidence.

options.title: Accept canonical migration
options.body: Confirm that Kimi Code’s current contract makes `k3` the correct wire id for all former `k3[1m]` configurations and merge after inspectable live proof is attached.

options.title: Preserve tier distinction
options.body: Keep a distinct compatibility mapping or defer the change if `k3[1m]` still carries a supported membership entitlement or behavior that `k3` does not represent.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical migration
recommendation.body: Confirm that Kimi Code’s current contract makes `k3` the correct wire id for all former `k3[1m]` configurations and merge after inspectable live proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the provider update and supplied the claimed Kimi Code validation, so they are the closest available contact for the Kimi contract evidence.
